limitations: Two seeded layouts are targeted checks, not a population success-rate estimate or a guarantee.
First-three success requires all three gears seated after parking and still seated at the recorded endpoint.
The central fourth gear is not yet reliable; failures and parameter variants are retained in the trial records.
Checkpoint continuations were diagnostic only and are excluded from fresh-trial totals.
Later ring placement and the separate recovery policy are unvalidated with the new torso posture.
Camera-disabled and camera-enabled runs have different warmup paths. Concurrent-run wall times are not throughput benchmarks.
The policy uses simulator poses; no physical-robot success or camera-only perception performance is established.
